subject: Runway to Go-live: MAP + Acceptance Tests / Handoff Timeline

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Runway to Go-live: MAP + Acceptance Tests / Handoff Timeline

Claire —

Thanks again for the time on the call earlier. As discussed, I drafted a short mutual action plan (attached) that maps the technical acceptance tests, decision gates, and the proposed close timeline. High level asks below; details are in MAP_draft_v2.xlsx.

Topline acceptance objectives (proposal):
- Quality: generation precision on our core 6 prompts >= 92% pass rate using your annotated rubric (see sheet 'Eval KPIs').
- Latency: p99 inference latency <= 450ms for 95% of API calls during the 50 rps load test.
- Reliability: no more than 1% errors at peak; successful fallback to smaller model under overload.
- Security & Compliance: data retention and audit logs validated against your SOC-2 checklist; KMS integration verified.

Exit gates (what signals sign off):
1) Eng sign-off on performance windows (p50/p95/p99) after two load runs.
2) Security checklist completed + evidence bundle (logs, config).
3) Mutual acceptance of sample responses across business-critical prompts (10/10 pass set).
4) Contract milestone: signature on SOW / committed capacity (Procurement).

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize MAP and acceptance matrix (you & procurement).
- Week 1: infra validation + first load run (Redwood + HealthSync eng).
- Week 2: acceptance runs, QA sample review, security evidence handoff.
- Week 3: contract signature and go/no-go decision; cutover window scheduled.

Action items for HealthSync: please confirm the three business-critical prompts you'd like included in the acceptance set and loop in procurement for contract milestones. I can consolidate and send a final version for signature.

Attachments: MAP_draft_v2.xlsx (workflow & test matrix).

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

Thanks Rishi — this is very helpful. Quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Prompts: we'll send the 3 canonical prompts by EOD tomorrow (they're PII-free variants).
2) Latency: our bar is tight for one of the real-time flows; can we add an intermediate p90 target to the matrix (we can tolerate p99 spikes but want p90 <= 300ms for that flow).
3) Security: can you confirm whether the audit logs export will include per-token metadata or just session metadata? We need per-session at minimum; per-token would be preferred if available.

Procurement — looping you in to align on the contract milestone cadence.

I'll review the MAP file with Eng and get back with comments by Wednesday.

Best,

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway to Go-live: MAP + Acceptance Tests / Handoff Timeline

Claire — good questions, answers inline.

- Prompts: perfect, we'll slot those into the acceptance matrix and mark expected outputs.
- Latency: we can add p90 <= 300ms as a conditional acceptance gate specifically for the realtime flow. We'll note p99 <= 450ms as the broader SLA target.
- Audit logs: current export includes session-level metadata (session_id, timestamp, prompt hash, model_version) and token-level timing for debug runs. Per-token content is not exported to persistent logs unless you opt into debug trace (we can provide an evidence bundle under NDA). We'll include the exact log schema in the MAP attachment.

Acceptance tests we will run (summary):
- Functional: 10 deterministic prompts, compare against expected canonical outputs (pass if >=92% similarity by rubric).
- Load: two 30-minute runs at nominal and 2x nominal load to measure p50/p90/p99 and error rates.
- Failover: force-inject degraded GPU (simulate node failure) and verify fallback model maintains functional correctness on a 20-sample smoke set.
- Security: KMS sign/verify step, retention policy export, and audit log sample (sanitized).

Timeline tweak: move handoff week (Week 2) to include a joint review meeting where we go through the evidence bundle live. Suggested times: Thu Jul 22 or Fri Jul 23 morning — what works for your Eng leads?

Marissa — we expect Procurement to require a small milestone-bound credit for the initial reserved capacity. Can you draft the contract milestone language we can share with Procurement?

Thanks,
Rishi

- Milestone 2 (Acceptance): Successful completion of acceptance tests (as defined in MAP), release of remainder of committed capacity billing.
- Milestone 3 (Go-live): Full capacity and SLA effective date.

I attached a short contract snippet we typically use; happy to adapt to HealthSync's legal template. Also tagging Grace for billing cadence alignment.
